one_liner: Meta Ads is a cloud advertising platform with a broad, documented Marketing API, a no-spend developer sandbox, and an official hosted MCP server launched in open beta.

auth.notes: Use OAuth 2.0 authorization-code consent when onboarding advertisers. System-user access tokens are documented for unattended server-to-server integrations.

access.notes: Meta’s App Dashboard Quickstart lets developers create a sandbox ad account and generate an access token without a payment method. Sandbox ads do not run, and reporting data is mock. Managing other advertisers’ accounts in production requires Advanced Access to the relevant permissions through Meta App Review. Advanced Access for permissions is distinct from the Marketing API’s Limited and Full access tiers.

api.notes: The public reference documents versioned HTTP endpoints for reporting and for managing campaigns, ad sets, and ads. Insights are available at the account, campaign, ad-set, and ad levels.

mcp.notes: Meta’s hosted server supports reporting and campaign management. Meta announced open beta on April 29, 2026; no general-availability announcement was verified.

verdict.rationale: Developers can build and test campaign management and reporting tools with the free sandbox and public Marketing API. Managing other advertisers’ accounts in production requires Meta App Review to grant Advanced Access to the relevant permissions.

evidence.quote: You can then build the URL for an API call that includes the endpoint for getting a token, your app ID, your site URL, your app secret, and the authorization code you just received: https://graph.facebook.com/ v27.0 /oauth/access_token? client_id=<YOUR_APP_ID> &redirect_uri=<YOUR_URL> &client_secret=<YOUR_APP_SECRET> &code=<AUTHORIZATION_CODE>
System user access tokens are useful for server-to-server interactions where there is no user present to authenticate.

A sandbox ad account lets you test ad creation and reporting using the Facebook Marketing API without incurring charges. These ad accounts don’t require a payment method and the ads you create won’t run.
In the popup select the permissions to associate with your access token and click Get Token . This token is valid for 2 months.
If your app is managing other people’s ad accounts, you need advanced access to the ads_read and/or ads_management permissions.
Advanced access must be approved through the App Review process on an individual permission and feature basis.

The API provides functions for ad creation, management, and performance analysis. You can programmatically generate ad campaigns, ad sets, and individual ads, deploying and adjusting them based on real-time performance data.
By default, GET requests will return basic metrics for the ad object, typically from the past 30 days.
The server is remote-hosted at https://mcp.facebook.com/ads and works with any MCP-compatible AI agent.

That's why today, we're announcing Meta ads AI connectors in open beta — built for businesses of all sizes across regions to create, manage, and analyze campaigns directly in the AI tools they already use.

Securely connect your AI agents and chatbots (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc) with Metaads MCP or direct API to create campaigns, pull ad performance data, update budgets, and generate custom reports through natural language.

problems: The MCP setup URL checked returned only Meta’s generic navigation, so client-specific setup was not verified.
The sandbox and authorization findings are based on public documentation; no credentials were issued or live calls tested.
name: Meta Ads

verification.note: The authorization-code token exchange supports oauth2, and the documented system-user access token supports bearer_token. Nothing quoted recommends a different primary method.

The quotes support a no-payment sandbox for API testing and a self-service token-generation step. They also support App Review for managing other people’s ad accounts. Mock reporting data and the distinction between Marketing API access tiers are not shown.

The public API quotes support ad creation, management, performance analysis, and GET requests; nothing contradicts broad breadth. The claimed availability of insights at every listed object level is not fully shown.
Vendor documentation identifies a hosted server, and the vendor announcement labels the ads AI connectors open beta. The quoted announcement does not establish the claimed April 29, 2026 date.
The quote is from Composio’s Metaads toolkit page.
The free sandbox and documented, broad API support building now. App Review for permissions needed to manage other people’s ad accounts supports the review-step caveat and admin_approval blocker.
